mapper.sql: configuration.current_evaluation_year AS "currentEvaluationYear", configuration.default_query_year AS "defaultQueryYear", target.target_year AS "targetYear", target.baseline_copy_yn AS "baselineCopyYn", target.initialization_yn AS "initializationYn"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reference_year_setting target JOIN reference_year_setting configuration ON configuration.target_year IS NULL AND configuration.deleted_yn = 'N' WHERE target.target_year = #{targetYear} AND target.deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reference_year_setting ( reference_year_setting_id, current_evaluation_year, default_query_year, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{settingId}, #{request.currentEvaluationYear}, #{request.defaultQueryYear}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} ) ON CONFLICT ((1)) WHERE deleted_yn = 'N' AND target_year IS NULL DO UPDATE SET current_evaluation_year = EXCLUDED.current_evaluation_year, default_query_year = EXCLUDED.default_query_year, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO reference_year_setting ( reference_year_setting_id, target_year, baseline_copy_yn, initialization_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{settingId}, #{request.targetYear}, #{request.baselineCopyYn}, #{request.initializationYn}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} ) ON CONFLICT (target_year) WHERE deleted_yn = 'N' AND target_year IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET baseline_copy_yn = EXCLUDED.baseline_copy_yn, initialization_yn = EXCLUDED.initialization_yn, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO change_history (change_history_id, entity_name, entity_id, before_value, after_value, actor_user_id, changed_at, status) VALUES (#{changeHistoryId}, 'reference_year_setting', #{entityId}, CAST(#{beforeValue} AS jsonb), CAST(#{afterValue} AS jsonb), #{actorUserId}, current_timestamp, 'RECORDED')
